description_en: Query statistics entries for an application
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc list-service-entries --service-id c910061f-0000-44e6-b659-000c --iot-cloud-connector-id iotcc-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListServiceEntries

parameters.help_en: The globally unique ID that the system assigns to the application-based statistics service
parameters.help_zh: 系统为分应用统计服务生成的ID，全网唯一
parameters.name: service_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud connector instance
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_id

parameters.help_en: The destination address of the service entry
parameters.name: target

parameters.help_en: The type of the destination address of the service entry
parameters.help_zh: 应用条目的目的地址类型
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en: The status of the service entry
parameters.name: service_entry_status

parameters.help_en: The name of the service entry
parameters.name: service_entry_name

parameters.help_en:
The token used for the next query. Valid values:

Leave this parameter empty for the first query or when no more results are available.

If more results are available, set this parameter to the value of NextToken returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100。默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The region ID where the service entries reside.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
应用条目所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数

NextToken.description_en:
The token used for the next query. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no more results are available.

If NextToken has a value, use it as the starting token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

ServiceEntryDescription.description_en:
The description of the service entry.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It must start with a letter or Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
ServiceEntryDescription.description_zh:
应用条目的描述。

长度为2~256个字符，开头必须为大小写英文字母或中文，但不能为`http://`或`https://`

ServiceEntryId.description_en: The ID of the service entry

ServiceEntryName.description_en:
The name of the service entry.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or Chinese character. It can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
ServiceEntryName.description_zh:
应用条目的名称。

长度为2~128个英文或中文字符，开头必须为大小写英文字母或中文，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）

ServiceEntryStatus.description_en:
The status of the service entry. Valid values:

Creating: The service entry is being created.

Created: The service entry is created.

Deleting: The service entry is being deleted.

Updating: The service entry is being updated
ServiceEntryStatus.description_zh:
应用条目的状态。取值：

Creating：创建中。

Created：已创建。

Deleting：删除中。

Updating：更新中

ServiceId.description_en: The globally unique ID that the system assigns to the application-based statistics service
ServiceId.description_zh: 系统为分应用统计服务生成的ID，全网唯一

Target.description_en: The destination address of the service entry

TargetType.description_en:
The type of the destination address of the service entry. Valid values:

Cidr: A CIDR block.

Domain: A domain name
TargetType.description_zh:
应用条目的目的地址类型。取值：

Cidr：CIDR地址块。

Domain：域名

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries in the list
